name: AI Engine
description: Machine learning components: face detection, 128-dim embedding extraction, liveness CNN inference, and model training/dataset pipelines.

name: API Layer
description: FastAPI application entry point exposing REST endpoints for auth, face enrollment, and attendance check-in.

name: Security
description: JWT-based authentication, bcrypt password hashing, and OAuth2 token validation for teacher accounts.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLAlchemy ORM models, SQLite database session management, and seed data for development.

name: Frontend
description: React SPA built with Vite: login page, teacher dashboard for class selection, kiosk mode for live facial attendance, and face enrollment UI.
